title: 第5章 事已至此先吃饭吧第6章 腐尸当地居民热情过头了
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
菲尔德在女仆装里加入了现代元素，裙摆裁剪到膝盖之上，袖子也改为短袖，虽然没有最重要的黑丝或白丝，但看着晶莹圆润的脚趾，和光滑白洁的大腿，已经算是赏心悦目。
“很合身。”阿诗娜受不了猜测的折磨，带着戏谑的语气，仿佛看穿了菲尔德的目的，“大人，要我做什么吗？”
她的工作，女仆们说是陪眼前的男人睡觉。但阿诗娜觉得可能性不大，因为人类很讨厌亚人，长着动物的耳朵和尾巴，让人类觉得，这是被动物玷污的人类血脉，就像去对山羊图谋不轨后生下的魔鬼杂种一般。
“当然是协助我开拓领地，我刚才说了。”菲尔德理所当然地回答，见阿诗娜一脸不相信，只好捂着额头无奈道，“先吃饭吧，咱们边吃边聊。”
听到吃饭，阿诗娜立刻平静下来，她饿得肚子都在燃烧。
菲尔德的处境很艰难，光是行为举止上，被一众兄弟姐妹厌恶并不算什么。
但老伯爵的身体一天不如一天，他手中的巨额财产将要进行分配，哪怕菲尔德不受宠，但神圣狮鹫帝国的律法规定，只要直系血脉，就有分配财产的权利。
相当于异世界版的推恩令，将大块的领地分为小块，避免某个领主过于强大。
所以，菲尔德的兄弟们自然希望菲尔德原地升天，他们之间也彼此仇视敌对。
用餐铃响起不久，两个举止端庄的女仆，端着酱汁肉排和蜂蜜面包进来。
“阿诗娜，你拥有哎，人呢？”
斟酌词汇的菲尔德，一转眼发现阿诗娜不见了，顿时满脸懵圈。
“我在这。”
阿诗娜用鸭子坐的姿势，安分地坐在墙角的地上。
“你在干嘛？”菲尔德震惊道。
“呃坐着等吃饭，大人，我那里做错了吗？”阿诗娜又紧张起来。
菲尔德大步走上前，一把拽住她的手，将其牵到桌边“坐到椅子上来，现在吃饭。”
阿诗娜只敢坐三分之一的凳子，她盯着菲尔德看了许久，确定眼前的贵族大人没有掏出鞭子或者肉鞭子。
“你没有开玩笑，我能吃这个吗？”阿诗娜指指香气四溢的肉排。
菲尔德摊摊手“当然。”

可怜的兽耳娘见菲尔德不像开玩笑，这才小心翼翼低下头啃了一口肉排。下一刻，带着香辛料和酱汁的肉味在口腔中绽放，不知道多久没尝过肉味的味蕾，简直在疯狂的起舞。
这是世界最美好的东西！
将所有的一切抛之脑后，阿诗娜快速吞下盘子中的肉排，并将汤汁舔的一干二净。
随后，阿诗娜一个人消灭了三块肉排和五个白面包，最后肚子变得和怀孕一般，这才放弃了进食。
菲尔德露出老父亲一般慈祥的笑容。
content_en:
Field added modern elements to the maid uniform. The skirt was cut above the knees and the sleeves were changed to short sleeves. Although it did not have the most important black silk or white silk, it was already pleasing to the eye to see the crystal round toes and smooth white thighs.
"It fits very well." Asheina couldn't stand the torment of speculation, and with a joking tone, as if she had seen through Field's purpose, "Sir, what do you want me to do?"
Her job, the maids said, was to sleep with the man in front of her. But Asuna thinks it is unlikely, because humans hate demi-humans, who have animal ears and tails, which makes humans think that this is human blood tainted by animals, just like a devil bastard born after plotting against a goat.
"Of course you are helping me expand my territory, as I just said." Field replied matter-of-factly. Seeing Ashina's disbelief, he could only cover his forehead and said helplessly, "Let's eat first, let's chat while we eat."
Asuna immediately calmed down when she heard about eating. She was so hungry that her stomach was burning.
Field's situation is very difficult. Just because of his behavior, being hated by all his brothers and sisters is nothing.
But the old earl's health was deteriorating day by day, and the huge property in his hands was about to be distributed. Even if Field was not favored, the laws of the Holy Griffin Empire stipulated that anyone with direct bloodline had the right to distribute property.
It is equivalent to the different world version of the push order, which divides a large territory into small pieces to prevent a certain lord from becoming too powerful.
Therefore, Field's brothers naturally hope that Field will ascend to heaven where he is, and they also hate each other.
Not long after the dinner bell rang, two maids with dignified manners came in carrying steaks with sauce and honey bread.
"Ashina, you have it, where is the person?"
Field was thinking about the words, but in the blink of an eye he realized that Asheena was missing, and he was immediately confused.
"I'm here."
Asheina sat peacefully on the ground in the corner in a duck-sitting posture.
"What are you doing?" Field asked in shock.
"Uh, sit and wait for dinner, sir, did I do something wrong?" Asuna became nervous again.
Field strode forward, grabbed her hand, and led her to the table, "Sit on the chair and eat now."
Asuna only dared to sit on one third of the stool. She stared at Field for a long time to make sure that the noble man in front of her did not take out a whip or a meat whip.
"You're not kidding, can I eat this?" Asheina pointed to the fragrant steak.
Field spread his hands, "Of course."
Seeing that Field didn't seem to be joking, the poor animal-eared girl carefully lowered her head and took a bite of the steak. The next moment, the flavor of meat with spices and sauces bloomed in the mouth, and the taste buds, which had not tasted meat for an unknown period of time, were dancing like crazy.
This is the most beautiful thing in the world!
Throwing everything behind, Asuna quickly swallowed the steak on the plate and licked the soup cleanly.
Afterwards, Asheina ate three pieces of steak and five pieces of white bread by herself. Finally, her stomach became as pregnant as before, and she gave up eating.
Field smiled like an old father.
